provenance.generatedBy: claude-opus-5-5 · Field Kit v2 Prompt A batch
provenance.notes: Out family batch. Seasonal spike work with almost no online presence: the kit leans on sod-versus-seed decisions, measuring, delivery day and the first month of watering. No sod farm or seed brands named. Ranges are planning figures, not quotes.

pageStructurePlus.section: Sod, seed or overseed: which one fits
pageStructurePlus.contains: Instant sod versus seeding versus overseeding a thin lawn, compared on cost, how fast you can walk on it, best months and how much watering each needs
pageStructurePlus.why: Most buyers start by asking whether they really need sod. A straight comparison earns trust and the right-sized job.

pageStructurePlus.contains: Killing off the old lawn, sod cutting and removal, grading for drainage, topsoil and amendments, laying sod with tight seams, rolling and the first watering
pageStructurePlus.why: Prep is invisible once the sod is down. Showing it explains why one quote is higher and why that lawn lives.

pageStructurePlus.section: Measuring your yard and sod delivery day
pageStructurePlus.contains: How to measure square footage, pallet counts, where the pallets go, access for the skid steer, same-day install and what happens if it rains
pageStructurePlus.why: Sod is perishable and arrives on a pallet. Clear logistics make the booking feel safe and stop day-of surprises.

pageStructurePlus.section: New sod watering and first-month care
pageStructurePlus.contains: Watering schedule by week, how to check the roots are taking, first mow timing, keeping dogs and kids off, and signs of trouble
pageStructurePlus.why: New sod dies from watering mistakes, and the installer gets blamed. A care page protects the warranty and the review.

pageStructurePlus.contains: Lawns for new builds, regrading after a pool, septic or drainage dig, compacted fill, and coordinating with builders and other trades
pageStructurePlus.why: Builders and other trades leave dirt behind. A page aimed at them brings repeat renovation work.

designDirections.name: Green by Friday
designDirections.bestFor: Small sod crews selling one-day installs during the spring and autumn spikes

designDirections.name: Dirt to Lawn
designDirections.bestFor: Lawn renovation outfits with a stack of bare-dirt to new-lawn transformations
designDirections.headlineSample: Lawn renovation and new sod in {City}
designDirections.whyItFits: The family's combo. Brick and linen let fresh green carry the colour, and slab headings feel like a work truck's lettering.

designDirections.name: Rooted
designDirections.bestFor: Renovation specialists who win on soil prep, grading and long-term lawn health

openers.line: Someone in {City} staring at a patchy, weedy yard searches for sod installation and finds {Business Name} with no site. They want to see a dirt-to-green job before they call.
openers.hook: Open their Maps listing and confirm there's no Website button. Screenshot it for when they reply.
openers.linkLine: What that homeowner would find instead: {demo-link}

openers.line: Your listing goes to Facebook, where the backyard you sodded last week is already buried. A homeowner deciding between sod and seed wants answers and a quote form, not a feed.
openers.hook: Tap the link and confirm it goes to Facebook. Note the newest sod job there.
openers.linkLine: A sod and renovation site instead of a feed: {demo-link}

openers.line: Your site is a single free-host page with a phone number and a stock lawn. For a crew that lays real sod, that sells you short.
openers.hook: Open the site and look for stock pictures, a builder banner or an old year. Note which.
openers.linkLine: Same sod crew, with real jobs on show: {demo-link}

openers.line: On a phone your sod site's quote form cuts off the submit button. People price new sod standing in the bare yard with their phone.
openers.hook: Only if they have a site. Load it on a phone and note what breaks. Screenshot it for when they reply.
openers.linkLine: Your sod quote form, working on a phone: {demo-link}

openers.line: Right now a sod quote with {Business Name} starts with a call and a guess at square footage. A form that asks size, sun and old-lawn removal would let you price it before visiting.
openers.hook: Check listing, bios and any site for a quote form. If none, the angle holds.
openers.linkLine: A sod quote form with square footage and removal: {demo-link}

openers.line: Your time-lapse of pallets turning into a finished lawn is the best sales tool a sod crew can have. It's gone from your feed in a week.
openers.hook: Find a time-lapse or install video. Mention it if they reply.
openers.linkLine: Your sod installs, kept where buyers can find them: {demo-link}

openers.angle: Reviews about the new lawn taking
openers.line: Your reviews mention sod that rooted in two weeks and a crew that left the yard graded perfectly. That's what the next buyer worries about, and it stays on your listing.
openers.hook: Copy one review phrase about rooting, grading or the crew. Quote it back if they reply.
openers.linkLine: Those reviews next to the lawns they describe: {demo-link}

openers.line: Sod season is short: a few weeks in spring and again in early autumn. The crew homeowners find before it starts is the one booked out first.
openers.hook: Use in late winter or late summer, before the spike. Name the season.

openers.line: People decide to fix the lawn on a Saturday, after the neighbour's barbecue on perfect grass. A sod quote form that works that night catches them while they care.
openers.hook: Call on a weekend. If it goes to voicemail, the angle holds.
openers.linkLine: A sod quote request that works on a weekend: {demo-link}

openers.line: Saw you're hiring for sod season. Seasonal workers pick the crew that looks like it has steady work.
openers.hook: Only if they posted a hiring note. Note the date.
openers.linkLine: A sod company site with a careers page: {demo-link}

openers.line: The new subdivisions around {City} are full of builder lawns that died the first summer. Nothing tells someone in {Neighborhood} you renovate lawns there.
openers.hook: Look for new-build neighbourhoods in their area or tags. Use one by name.
openers.linkLine: A lawn renovation page for each neighbourhood: {demo-link}

openers.line: If you let customers do the front lawn now and the back next season, say so on the site. A full lawn renovation is easier to say yes to in halves.
openers.hook: Only if they mention phasing or payment plans. Otherwise skip.

openers.line: Sod buyers worry the new lawn will die and nobody will answer. Your insurance and a clear rooting promise with watering rules on one page settles that.
openers.hook: Look for any mention of a warranty or insurance. Note what's there; never invent terms.
openers.linkLine: Insurance and sod promise, stated plainly: {demo-link}

openers.angle: The greenest yard on the street
openers.line: A freshly sodded yard is the greenest on the street overnight. The neighbours ask who did it, then look up the sod company.
openers.hook: Look for reviews or comments mentioning neighbours. Quote it back.
openers.linkLine: Where the next sod referral would land: {demo-link}

openers.line: That {specific recent job} you posted is a clean sod install, tight seams and a level grade. That lawn should be the first thing a stranger sees.
openers.hook: Pick their newest sod or renovation post and name it: size, grass type, town if tagged.
openers.linkLine: That new lawn, front and centre: {demo-link}

IF YES:
"What did you think?"
 → let them talk, then ask how quotes reach them in sod season
"It's {Build Range} depending on how many pages you want, then {Care Range} a month for hosting and changes. For your crew I'd quote about {Build Price}, roughly one backyard of sod."
"Ten minutes this week to go through it?"

CLOSE:

objections.objection: Sod season is only a few weeks; I don't need a site all year.
objections.handler: "That's exactly why. When the season is short, every quote you miss in those weeks is gone. The form takes square footage while you're laying pallets."

objections.objection: I get work from builders and landscapers.
objections.handler: "Those are great. Homeowner renovations pay better, and they search before they call. The site catches them."

objections.objection: People just ask for the price per pallet.
objections.handler: "The renovation page shows what's under the sod: removal, grading, topsoil. That's what turns a pallet price into a full lawn job."

objections.objection: My cousin is doing a site for me.
objections.handler: "Good. Happy to hand over the sod-versus-seed page and the quote form. If it's not live before the season, the offer stands."

objections.objection: I'm on a lead site already.
objections.handler: "Those sod leads go to several crews at once. Your own site sends the homeowner straight to you."
"{Build Range}. For you about {Build Price}: sod versus seed, a square-footage quote form, the watering guide and a few neighbourhood pages."

bullets: Price for a short season: the build should pay back from a couple of sod jobs in the first spike.
The square-footage quote form is the heart of the site; price it as its own line.
Sell the watering guide as part of every build; it protects reviews and cuts warranty calls.
Add a builder and new-construction page only for crews who want trade work.
Keep monthly products small and seasonal; offer to pause care in the dead months if needed.
Count before-and-after pairs, not pages, when sizing the gallery.

lineItems.item: New sod watering guide with reminders
lineItems.description: Max when the guide links to a text reminder sign-up by install date.
Max with grouped pairs by job type and short captions on prep.
Max with a trade request form and lot-by-lot scheduling notes.
Max when each page shows lawns from that area and its soil notes.

whatElseYouSell.name: Pallet-to-lawn time-lapse shoot
whatElseYouSell.pitchLine: "A camera on a pole films the whole sod install, bare dirt to green in under a minute. That clip is the hero of the site and a season of posts."
whatElseYouSell.when: Month 2, on the next full-yard sod job.

whatElseYouSell.name: Google profile posts of new lawns
whatElseYouSell.pitchLine: "Every new sod lawn goes on your Maps profile with the neighbourhood during the season, so the listing looks busy when it matters."

whatElseYouSell.name: Review asks once the sod roots
whatElseYouSell.pitchLine: "Two weeks after install, when the homeowner can tug the sod and it holds, they get a text asking for a review."

whatElseYouSell.name: Pre-season sod campaign
whatElseYouSell.pitchLine: "A short campaign before the spring and autumn windows aimed at neighbourhoods with tired lawns books your best weeks early."
whatElseYouSell.when: Pitch a month before each window.

whatElseYouSell.name: Yard signs on new lawns
whatElseYouSell.pitchLine: "A 'new sod, keep off' sign is needed anyway. Put your name and site on it and the street reads it for weeks."

whatElseYouSell.name: Builder and realtor one-sheet
whatElseYouSell.pitchLine: "A one-page sheet for builders and listing agents showing your sod turnaround and lawn renovation pricing approach."
whatElseYouSell.when: Month 3, once the builder page is live.

withoutAI.route: The sod farm you buy pallets from
withoutAI.pitchLine: "Your sod farm sells to every installer in the region and has a price list for a website. Introduce me and I'll build their installer directory and order page."
withoutAI.whyItWorks: Farms have budgets and a customer list that is your prospect list.

withoutAI.route: Pool and septic contractors who leave bare dirt
withoutAI.whoPays: The pool or septic contractor, at your normal rate
withoutAI.pitchLine: "Every pool dig and septic job ends with a torn-up lawn. Those contractors need sites, and they'll send the lawn restoration to you."
withoutAI.whyItWorks: Their job ends where yours starts; the referral is natural.

withoutAI.route: Irrigation companies that keep new sod alive
withoutAI.whoPays: The irrigation company, at your normal rate
withoutAI.pitchLine: "New sod needs working sprinklers. The irrigation tech who checks systems before you lay needs a site, and the referral runs both ways."
withoutAI.whyItWorks: Same yard, same week, two trades depending on each other.

withoutAI.route: Lawn mowing crews who take over after install
withoutAI.whoPays: The mowing company, at your normal rate
withoutAI.pitchLine: "After your sod roots, someone mows it weekly. The mowing crew you hand off to needs a site, and they'll send renovations back."
withoutAI.whyItWorks: Mowers see failing lawns every week; you see new ones needing mowing.

withoutAI.pitchLine: "The builder whose lots you sod needs a site that shows finished homes with real lawns, not bare dirt."
withoutAI.whyItWorks: Builders need better listing presentation and trust the sod crew.

withoutAI.route: Dog trainers and pet owners' groups
withoutAI.whoPays: The dog trainer, at your normal rate
withoutAI.pitchLine: "Dogs wreck lawns, and dog trainers hear about it. Their site can send lawn repair your way."
withoutAI.whyItWorks: A small but steady two-way referral.

withAI.route: Pallet calculator and order assistant for the sod farm
withAI.pitchLine: "Installers and homeowners enter the yard size and get pallet counts, grass suggestions and a delivery slot from that farm."
withAI.whyItWorks: Fewer wrong orders and a reason to buy from one farm.

withAI.route: Restoration scope helper for pool and septic crews
withAI.pitchLine: "After the dig, the crew uploads pictures and the assistant drafts a lawn restoration scope to send the homeowner with your sod partner's quote."
withAI.whyItWorks: They hand off cleanly and your client gets every torn-up lawn.

withAI.route: Sprinkler readiness check for the irrigation company
withAI.pitchLine: "Before a sod install, homeowners answer a few questions and the assistant flags whether the sprinkler system needs a check first."
withAI.whyItWorks: It books irrigation visits and protects the new lawn.

withAI.pitchLine: "The builder uploads a bare-dirt lot and gets a clearly labelled preview with a finished lawn, then books the sod crew from the same screen."
withAI.whyItWorks: Builders sell homes faster; your client gets the lots.

withAI.route: Handoff messages for the mowing crew
withAI.pitchLine: "When new sod is ready for its first mow, the homeowner gets an introduction to the mowing partner with a sign-up link."
withAI.whyItWorks: The mowing crew gets new customers; the sod client looks thorough.

withAI.route: Yard repair advice bot for dog trainers
withAI.pitchLine: "Clients ask about dug-up and burned lawn spots; the assistant answers and offers a lawn repair quote from the sod partner."
withAI.whyItWorks: Small, cheap, and a steady trickle of repair work.

softwareAI.name: Missed-call text-back for sod quotes
softwareAI.pitchLine: "While you're unloading pallets, missed callers get a text asking the yard's square footage and whether the old lawn needs to come out."
softwareAI.whenAndWhatItTakes: Day 30. Needs their number forwarded and approved wording.

softwareAI.name: Sod price estimator by square foot
softwareAI.pitchLine: "Enter the yard size, pick lay-only or full renovation, and the homeowner sees a sod range before you visit."
softwareAI.whenAndWhatItTakes: Month 2. Needs their per-square-foot prices for lay-only, removal and grading.

softwareAI.name: Review reply drafts for new lawns
softwareAI.pitchLine: "Each review gets a reply drafted that mentions the new sod and how it rooted, ready to approve."
softwareAI.whenAndWhatItTakes: Month 2. Needs ten past replies. Comes with the AI maintenance retainer.

softwareAI.name: New sod watering text schedule
softwareAI.pitchLine: "From install day, the homeowner gets texts telling them how long to water each day, tapering over the first weeks. Fewer dead lawns, fewer angry calls."
softwareAI.whenAndWhatItTakes: Month 2. Needs their watering schedule by season.

softwareAI.name: Deposit and install-day billing
softwareAI.pitchLine: "Deposit locks the pallet order, the balance goes out the evening the sod is rolled, each with a card link."
softwareAI.whenAndWhatItTakes: Month 2. Needs their deposit rule and payment account.

softwareAI.name: Yard picture measurer for sod
softwareAI.pitchLine: "From the address and a few yard pictures, it drafts the sod area minus beds and driveway, for you to confirm before ordering pallets."
softwareAI.whenAndWhatItTakes: Month 4. Needs a set of past measured lawns. Comes with the AI maintenance retainer.

softwareAI.name: Season install calendar with pallet orders
softwareAI.pitchLine: "Every sod job in the season on one calendar with its pallet order and delivery day, so sod never sits a day on the driveway."
softwareAI.whenAndWhatItTakes: Month 3. Needs the farm's ordering lead times and their crew days.

softwareAI.name: Sod or seed advice chatbot
softwareAI.pitchLine: "It answers 'should I sod or seed in September' and 'can I lay sod over my old lawn' from your own guidance, then books a quote."
softwareAI.whenAndWhatItTakes: Month 3. Needs their answers written once. Comes with the AI maintenance retainer.

softwareAI.name: Rain reschedule notices
softwareAI.pitchLine: "When rain moves an install, the customer and the sod farm both get the new date from one button."
softwareAI.whenAndWhatItTakes: Month 3. Needs the install calendar in place.

softwareAI.name: After-hours sod quote line
softwareAI.pitchLine: "Evening callers get asked yard size, removal and timing, and a sod quote visit is booked on your calendar."
softwareAI.whenAndWhatItTakes: Month 4. Needs their calendar and questions. Comes with the AI maintenance retainer.

softwareAI.name: Rooting check-in and warranty log
softwareAI.pitchLine: "Each new lawn gets a two-week rooting check logged with a picture, so any warranty claim is checked against the record."
softwareAI.whenAndWhatItTakes: Month 4. Needs their warranty terms.

softwareAI.name: Lawn problem picture diagnosis
softwareAI.pitchLine: "Homeowners upload pictures of a dying lawn and the tool suggests whether it needs overseeding, new sod or a full renovation, for you to confirm."
softwareAI.whenAndWhatItTakes: Month 5. Needs labelled past lawn pictures. Comes with the AI maintenance retainer.

softwareAI.name: Builder lot schedule board
softwareAI.pitchLine: "Builders see which lots are graded, when sod is coming and when it's done, without calling the crew."
softwareAI.whenAndWhatItTakes: Month 6, once they have builder work. Needs lot lists.

softwareAI.name: Autumn overseeding offer sequence
softwareAI.pitchLine: "Past sod and renovation customers get an autumn overseeding and aeration offer. That's repeat lawn work in the second window of the year."
softwareAI.whenAndWhatItTakes: Month 6. Needs the customer list and their offer.

softwareAI.name: Voice notes to renovation quote
softwareAI.pitchLine: "Walk the yard, say the area, slope, removal and topsoil needs, and it drafts the lawn renovation quote."
softwareAI.whenAndWhatItTakes: Month 5. Needs their quote template and pricing. Comes with the AI maintenance retainer.

softwareAI.name: Customer portal with install day and watering plan
softwareAI.pitchLine: "Customers see their sod install day, the watering plan and their invoice in one place."
softwareAI.whenAndWhatItTakes: Month 6. Needs the install calendar and watering texts.

softwareAI.name: Job costing per pallet laid
softwareAI.pitchLine: "See what each sod job made per pallet once removal, topsoil, dump fees and crew hours are in."
softwareAI.whenAndWhatItTakes: Month 8. Needs a season of receipts and crew hours.

softwareAI.name: Grade and soil note drafter
softwareAI.pitchLine: "From the crew's notes it drafts a short write-up for the customer: what was graded, what was added to the soil, and why the lawn will drain."
softwareAI.whenAndWhatItTakes: Month 5. Needs their notes and approval. Comes with the AI maintenance retainer.

softwareAI.name: Season-spike crew sign-up chat
softwareAI.pitchLine: "For the few weeks of sod season you need extra hands fast. A short chat asks about lifting, start dates and transport, and books trial days for the sod crew."
softwareAI.whenAndWhatItTakes: Before each season. Needs their requirements and pay. Comes with the AI maintenance retainer.

softwareAI.name: Commercial lawn restoration bid sheet
softwareAI.pitchLine: "Bids for sports fields, church lawns and HOA commons come together with area, prep spec, sod type and references."
softwareAI.whenAndWhatItTakes: Month 9, for crews chasing commercial work. Needs two past bids.

routesToBiggerBuyer.route: Sod estimator and watering texts for every installer
routesToBiggerBuyer.whoPays: Sod and lawn renovation crews, monthly
routesToBiggerBuyer.pitchLine: "Every sod crew gets the same square-footage questions and the same dead-lawn complaints. The estimator and watering texts fix both for a small monthly fee."
routesToBiggerBuyer.whyItWorks: Built once, needed everywhere sod is laid.

routesToBiggerBuyer.route: Installer directory and order portal for a sod farm
routesToBiggerBuyer.whoPays: The sod farm or turfgrass grower
routesToBiggerBuyer.pitchLine: "Homeowners who visit your farm's site want someone to lay the sod. A directory of installers who buy from you sends them there."
routesToBiggerBuyer.whyItWorks: Growers want loyal installers and lack a homeowner channel.

routesToBiggerBuyer.whoPays: The turfgrass or landscape association, per bundle
routesToBiggerBuyer.pitchLine: "Members switch on a sod-versus-seed page, a square-footage quote form and watering texts with their dues."
routesToBiggerBuyer.whyItWorks: A practical perk for small sod crews.

routesToBiggerBuyer.pitchLine: "Seasonal sod clients can't afford a custom build. A ready sod template makes them profitable for an agency."
routesToBiggerBuyer.whyItWorks: It turns a small client into a viable one.

routesToBiggerBuyer.pitchLine: "Every home closing needs a lawn on time. A shared lot board with the sod crew stops closings slipping for bare dirt."
routesToBiggerBuyer.whyItWorks: Builders feel late lawns in delayed closings.

routesToBiggerBuyer.route: Sports field restoration portal for schools
routesToBiggerBuyer.whoPays: The school district or parks department
routesToBiggerBuyer.pitchLine: "Worn goal mouths and infields need new sod between seasons. A request and scheduling portal coordinates it with approved crews."
routesToBiggerBuyer.whyItWorks: Public grounds have budgets and visible complaints.

routesToBiggerBuyer.route: Water utility new-lawn watering exemption form
routesToBiggerBuyer.pitchLine: "Residents with new sod apply for a temporary watering exemption online, with the install date from the sod installer."
routesToBiggerBuyer.whyItWorks: Utilities handle these by phone; the sod client knows the paperwork.

routesToBiggerBuyer.pitchLine: "Lawn franchise territories get sod requests they can't fill. An add-on page that routes them to a local sod partner earns a fee."
routesToBiggerBuyer.whyItWorks: Franchises want add-on revenue without new crews.

routesToBiggerBuyer.route: Restoration partner page for pool builders
routesToBiggerBuyer.pitchLine: "Pool buyers worry about the torn-up yard. A lawn restoration page in your sales kit, with a named sod partner, answers that."
routesToBiggerBuyer.whyItWorks: It helps close pools and sends every restoration to your client.

routesToBiggerBuyer.pitchLine: "Sod crews quote in March without knowing what pallets will cost in May. Pool the invoices they send you into a one-page monthly sheet."
routesToBiggerBuyer.whyItWorks: Cheap, useful and honest because it's contributed.

routesToBiggerBuyer.whoPays: A sod company in another metro
routesToBiggerBuyer.pitchLine: "Sod season gives you a few weeks to fill the calendar. I set up one sod crew per metro with the estimator and watering texts; yours is open."
routesToBiggerBuyer.whyItWorks: Same template, new territory, seasonal urgency.

routesToBiggerBuyer.route: Revive sod sites with no quote form
routesToBiggerBuyer.whoPays: The sod company with a dead site
routesToBiggerBuyer.pitchLine: "If your sod site is a phone number and a stock lawn, I can add the square-footage form and watering guide before the season."

upsellLadder.offer: Sod site build plus care plan, one contract
upsellLadder.trigger: They say yes to the demo.
upsellLadder.line: "The sod site and the care plan are on one contract, so swapping the season banner is a text to me."

upsellLadder.trigger: The first sod install booked through the site.
upsellLadder.line: "Your first site customer gets sod Friday. Let's make sure they water it right with daily texts."

upsellLadder.offer: Review asks once the sod roots and profile posts
upsellLadder.trigger: Two weeks after the first install, the sod has rooted.
upsellLadder.line: "That sod has rooted. The homeowner's never happier than now, so let's ask for the review."

upsellLadder.trigger: A full-yard sod job is on the calendar.
upsellLadder.line: "Let's put a camera on your next full-yard sod job. Dirt to green in a minute sells the next one."

upsellLadder.offer: Sod price estimator by square foot
upsellLadder.trigger: Quote forms show many small or price-only requests.
upsellLadder.line: "Too many sod quotes go nowhere. A range up front filters them before you drive."

upsellLadder.trigger: Late summer, with a season of sod customers on file.
upsellLadder.line: "Every lawn you laid this spring is a candidate for autumn overseeding. One offer fills the second window."

upsellLadder.offer: Season install calendar with pallet orders
upsellLadder.trigger: Pallets sat overnight on a driveway, or they add a second crew for next season.
upsellLadder.line: "Sod that waits a day dies at the edges. One calendar tied to pallet orders stops it next season."
